rec.name: Sub-Collection Icon Pill Navigation
rec.status: Design approved — briefed to dev, icons being integrated

what.text: A horizontal row of pill-shaped tabs at the top of a collection page. Each pill links to a sub-collection and shows a small icon next to its label. The active sub-collection is highlighted with a green tint, green text and a green icon. The screenshot shows six pills: Neuheiten (New arrivals), Bundles, Startseite (Home page), Kategorieseite (Category page), Artikelseite (Product page) and Warenkorb (Cart). The sub-collections are organised by page type or theme.

why.text: Sub-collection pills show the available categories at a glance and let shoppers narrow a large collection in one tap, which cuts browsing effort and decision friction. The clear active state shows where the shopper is. Icons are quicker to scan than text alone. They also work better than product thumbnails here, because the products are too abstract or detailed to read at small size.

how.text: Create one Shopify collection per sub-collection. Build a collection-page section that renders a flex row of pills, each linking to its sub-collection URL. Give the current collection the active class. Each pill carries an inline SVG icon (the designer supplied SVG files whose code can be pasted in) plus the collection title. On mobile, make the row horizontally scrollable. The designer chose icons over product images on purpose and suggested A/B testing icons against images.

items: Icon vs. product-image display (suggested A/B test)

dependencies.text: Sub-collections must exist in Shopify. The SVG icon code per sub-collection must be pasted in, either hard-coded or stored as a metafield or setting. The requested list in the comments (Bestseller, Neuheiten, Startseite, Kategorieseite, Artikelseite, Warenkorb) differs slightly from the screenshot, which shows Bundles instead of Bestseller, so the final set needs confirming.

items: Conversion rate and revenue per session from collection pages

images.caption: Sub-collection pill row with icons. The 'Startseite' pill is active in green, and the other five pills are in the neutral state.
Icon-plus-label pills and the green active state, which are the configurable assets: icon, label and highlight colour.
